text: This report provides an update on the Port Lands Flood Protection project, which reached substantial completion on September 30, 2025. Since the last update to City Council in May of 2023 many important project milestones have been reached. These include: - Completion and opening of four new bridges (two on Cherry Street over the Keating Channel, one on Cherry Street Bridge over the new Don River and one bridge on Commissioners Street over the new Don River); - Reconstruction of the new Lake Shore Bridge over the Don River; - Removal of the old Cherry Street lift bridge over Keating Channel; - New water, sanitary and stormwater infrastructure along Cherry Street, Commissioners Street and Don Roadway; - Completion of a Flood Protection Landform underneath the new Don Roadway; - Completion, flooding and opening of the new Don River valley to Lake Ontario, with associated habitats and…
